scope_limit: Three laboratories with recurring bacterial strains; two development sites and one exposed reserved site. This is retrospective laboratory transfer, not new-strain generalization or independent confirmation. Unresolved source strain labels remain anchors, not split identities.
calibration_note: DSM/site-reference strain aliases resolved from source RefToDict plus explicit single-strain-study Overview links (source labeling discrepancies retained) and kept together. All ExperimentResults sheets included. Explicit untreated CFU lung single-value observations only, equality operator, compatible log-CFU lung units, numeric actual times 0–24 h. Time-zero animals form an explicitly allowed cohort calibration, not the same later animals. Non-numeric early-death times and censoring cannot be interpreted as exact scheduled times; exclusions are counted, and this creates survivorship/measurement selection limits. Source already reports virulence/reproducibility criteria; no new clinical efficacy claim. Source laboratory directory supplies validation identity; the original SITE field is inconsistent in one workbook and is preserved as provided_site. Header templates and source censoring inconsistencies require caution.
timing_contract: Initial cohort burden and time/site only. No post-baseline measured target is an input; study/strain IDs are anchors, not predictors.
exposure_notice: All packaged targets are exposed for future agents; future scoring is retrospective. Primary source label/DSM identities remained inconsistent. Earlier development used some later GSK targets. No independent confirmation claim is made after this metadata repair.

uncertainty.reason: Shared source system/people/materials, temporal dependence or small reserved-group counts do not justify precise population-level confidence. Group effects are descriptive; no row bootstrap.

review_criteria.name: Prediction-time information
review_criteria.requirement: Verify native anchors and permitted information: Initial cohort burden and time/site only. No post-baseline measured target is an input; study/strain IDs are anchors, not predictors.

review_criteria.name: Validation and leakage
review_criteria.requirement: Inspect complete training/tuning groups and processing fits. Keep linked units together. Distinguish original held-out evidence from the currently exposed cohort.

review_criteria.name: Executable equations and parameters
review_criteria.requirement: Reproduce submitted predictions; inspect correspondence between written equations and code, all coefficients, learned transformations, hidden calibration and model complexity.

review_criteria.name: Units and scientific interpretation
review_criteria.requirement: Check units, physical signs/limits, measurement preprocessing, identifiability and source-specific confounding. review_criteria.name: Controls, uncertainty and failures
review_criteria.requirement: Require falsifying tests, residual checks, sensitivity/ablation evidence and preserved negative results. Use independent groups rather than row-level pseudo-replication.

review_criteria.name: Comparators and practical value
review_criteria.requirement: Compare every frozen baseline under equal information/coverage; justify improvements in physical units and simplicity, not just best-case rows or extra fitted constants.

review_criteria.name: Prior work and novelty
review_criteria.requirement: Disclose source analyses and literature-search records. Separate reproduction from extension; a novelty claim requires independent literature and scientific adjudication.

review_criteria.name: Scope and reproducibility
review_criteria.requirement: State validated systems/conditions, failure modes and out-of-domain limits. Fresh scientific confirmation requires new, unexposed groups with a preregistered protocol.
